G1_unambiguity.justification: The polarity condition clearly forbids selecting both endpoints of any resonant link, giving one unambiguous interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies all input bounds, link restrictions, required selection size, output format, and acceptance conditions.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Assigning positive polarity to exactly k nodes while requiring every link's sum to be nonpositive is exactly equivalent to finding an independent set of size k.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, although the particle-trap framing is somewhat contrived for the underlying graph problem.
